name: Qt Quick (QML engine and scene graph)
listed_description: Qt declarative UI module (QML and Qt Quick) rendering through the GPU, presented as faster than the CPU-rendered QWidget raster engine for animated graphics.
reason: No numeric comparison against Qt Widgets reachable. Repo page (license dir, 298 stars) has no benchmark comparing Quick with QWidget; tests/benchmarks holds only particles, qml, quick (accessibility, colorresolving, curverenderer, events, qsggeometry) and quickcontrols, none against widgets. Web searches (3) surfaced only forum and mailing-list anecdotes, no controlled fps numbers; the one number found points the other way (embedded report: Qt Quick CPU up to 21% vs Qt Widgets 7% on mouse move, unknown Qt version and hardware, snippet only). Qt forum, mailing list and doc.qt.io hosts are blocked from this container (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND), so Qt's own docs could not be checked.

name: Qt Quick 3D
listed_description: Qt 6 module that renders 3D scenes in QML with native rendering, replacing the Qt 5 Qt Canvas 3D module that was built on three.js and WebGL.
reason: No numeric comparison against Qt Canvas 3D or three.js reachable. Repo page (75 stars, GPL v3 or commercial) shows no such benchmark; tests/benchmarks holds only culling, picking and renderer (tst_renderer.cpp, no Canvas3D or three.js mention). Web searches (2) found only the Qt 5.15 Qt Quick 3D benchmarking app blog (fps counter hardware test, not a cross-framework comparison), the Canvas 3D deprecation in 5.12 (low development activity, not performance) and no Canvas 3D versus Quick 3D numbers. qt.io, doc.qt.io and lists.qt-project.org are blocked from this container (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND).
